sn45.62:0.3: Accomplishment in Rational Application of Mind (2nd)
sn45.62:1.2: A bhikkhu accomplished in wise attention can expect to develop and cultivate the noble eightfold path.
sn45.62:1.3: And how does a bhikkhu accomplished in wise attention develop and cultivate the noble eightfold path?
sn45.62:1.4: It’s when a bhikkhu develops right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right concentration, which culminate in the removal of greed, hate, and delusion.
sn45.62:1.5: That’s how a bhikkhu accomplished in wise attention develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path.”
